CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 156

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

4. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 37

5. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 11

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

7. Solve for x: x + 9 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 19
   C. 10
   D. 9

8. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 26

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 43
   C. 49
   D. 41

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

11. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 65

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 3
   C. 11
   D. 29

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
